description: Defines the absl::StatusOr<T> template class and related exception class BadStatusOrAccess, including methods for handling success/error states, value access, and conversions.

classes.name: BadStatusOrAccess
classes.description: Exception class thrown when accessing an invalid StatusOr value.

classes.name: StatusOr
classes.description: Template class representing a value or an error status, with methods for access and error handling.

methods.name: BadStatusOrAccess::what
methods.description: Returns a string describing the error.

methods.name: StatusOr<T>::ok
methods.description: Checks if the object contains a valid value.

methods.name: StatusOr<T>::value
methods.description: Returns the contained value, throws or terminates if invalid.

methods.name: StatusOr<T>::operator*
methods.description: Dereferences to access the contained value.

methods.name: StatusOr<T>::operator->
methods.description: Returns pointer to the contained value.

methods.name: StatusOr<T>::value_or
methods.description: Returns the value or a default if invalid.
